Product Features

  • Intelligent hydraulic storage system. Thanks to a high-quality hydraulic rod, the bed frame is gently lifted and held securely, allowing for effortless opening. The extra-deep storage space under the bed is optimally utilized, offering room for seasonal bedding, heavy clothing, toy boxes, picture books, and other larger items. Children's rooms look neat and tidy in no time, fostering good tidiness habits from an early age.
  • Reversible Left or Right Configuration: Designed with flexibility in mind, the side panel can be installed on either the left or right side to suit your room layout. Whether you're moving home, redesigning a space, or simply changing furniture placement, this adaptable daybed easily adjusts to your needs.
  • Elegant Modern Daybed Design: Combining clean lines with a timeless silhouette, this upholstered daybed blends effortlessly into modern, Scandinavian, minimalist, or contemporary interiors. Its sophisticated design creates a cosy sleeping and lounging space while enhancing the overall look of any bedroom.
  • Expert Hand-Stitched Craftsmanship: Every upholstered edge is carefully hand-stitched by skilled craftsmen to achieve a smooth, refined, and premium finish. These meticulous details not only enhance durability but also reflect the care and craftsmanship invested in every piece.
  • High-quality, gentle on the skin for maximum comfort. The soft, plush bouclé fabric is incredibly cuddly and has a pleasant texture. Durable and skin-friendly, it offers a warm and cozy feel. Secure yours now and create a dreamy sleeping space for your child!.
